}}'''Varadin''' was a Whitecloak agent in [[Tarabon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Varadin}}

==History==
Varadin was a rug seller during the [[Whitecloak War]]. During this time, he peddled his wares through [[Altara]], [[Murandy]] and [[Illian]], all the while providing "good service" to [[Pedron Niall]]. He was one of Niall's best personal agents. From the profit he made during those years, Varadin set himself up as a wealthy merchant in [[Tanchico]] trading in fine carpets and wines. He regularly supplies to both the [[Andric|King of Tarabon]] and the [[Panarch]], as well as many important nobles. Each time he visits, he comes back with his eyes and ears full.{{ref/book|6|9}}

==Activities==
Varadin sends messages warning about strange creatures, flying beasts, Aes Sedai on leashes and the "[[Hailene]]". Niall thinks he has gone insane.{{ref/book|6|9}} After more reports from other people, Niall takes Varadin's second message from Tarabon more seriously.{{ref/book|6|31}} [[Asidim Faisar]], another Child of the Light, sends Niall a report confirming Varadin's earlier messages.{{ref/book|7|Prologue}}
